description: "CWEs derived from / under [N]" / "child weaknesses of [CWE]" / "more specific variants of [X]" — list immediate children of a CWE in the relationship tree. CWE is hierarchical; e.g. children of CWE-119 (memory bounds) include CWE-787 (out-of-bounds write) and CWE-125 (out-of-bounds read).
name: children
